    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.124.1...0.125.0">0.125.0</a> (2026-10-23)</h2>
<h3>⚠ BREAKING CHANGES</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> make jks-js an optional peer dependency (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11739" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11739/hovercard">#11739</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> make Claude Agent and Codex SDKs opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11134" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11134/hovercard">#11134</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>add provider-only environment overrides (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11889" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11889/hovercard">#11889</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/2eed6e176eb8a07c43eb57de5c2c4d3d621fd9d2">2eed6e1</a>)</li>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> add rouge-l and rouge-s assertion types (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10256" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10256/hovercard">#10256</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/6842fc3932e42d3a0da6feb42f51a1b656b378bf">6842fc3</a>)</li>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> filter trace spans by attributes (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10648/hovercard">#10648</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/faf08b45e17675a89b42c016589eae848964bb2c">faf08b4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> optional Unicode normalization for equals and contains (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10555" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10555/hovercard">#10555</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/92ae1ecc6f4332c7198a9caea0f8cfaf0a2d75f2">92ae1ec</a>)</li>
<li><strong>eval:</strong> add safe mode to disable inline JavaScript execution (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11382" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11382/hovercard">#11382</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/80a27b663efc77f2d43d85229a9391d8cc3c2524">80a27b6</a>)</li>
